description: Read the status of a trusted-device approval session: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED or EXPIRED. An approved transfer is sent by Lovie on its own, so this status never asks you to send anything: to learn whether a transfer went through, call get_transfer_draft_outcome with its draft_id instead. Poll once per user prompt, not in a loop; a session expires about 5 minutes after it was opened.
name: approval_session_get_approval_session_status
title: Get Approval Session Status
